statement: A confidence event gives delta(C)<=eta(C), so whole-calibration TV<=P(E_complement)+E[1_E eta(C)], not alpha+eta(C_observed). With a predeclared0.16 gate and reference for failed/aborted/unavailable qualification, conditional error is <=0.16 on every successful history and unconditional TV<=0.17. The saved0.1202586 remains a valid observed99%-confidence certificate. Root final wrapper handles missing/incomplete/bad-normalizer/failed-gate cases without resampling; earlier reviewed wrapper scope remains distinct.
